name: henni
description: A voxel pet for a website: a tiny software-rendered me who follows your cursor, lives through his day and hosts podcast guests, with TypeSafe's Jev deciding what he does next.

scripts.build: python3 tools/colorways.py && node tools/build-pet.mjs && node tools/build-guests.mjs
scripts.test: node --test jev/jev-proxy.test.mjs && node tools/guests-test.mjs pet.js && node tools/jev-test.mjs pet.js
